name: gift-economy-contribution-tracker
description: Track and visualize gifts, favors, and contributions in a gift economy

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w backend && npm run format:check -w frontend
